posts.text: Ever since the company announced and the board approved the migration of shares to BSE and NSE from SME, the stock is on a downward trend. It looks like “sell the approval” is playing out. The board approved the SME-to-main-board migration and direct NSE listing on August 17, with a postal ballot running August 21 to September 19, 2026. The anticipation of a main-board move is getting priced in and once the event is formally approved, early holders are booking the profits. Rich valuation multiples could be another reason.
